name: Dax
summary: Born on Trill in 2018, the Dax symbiont has lived more than eleven centuries through at least ten hosts: a legislator, an engineer, an Olympic gymnast, the head of the Symbiosis Commission, a pilot, a murderer the Commission hid, a Federation ambassador, two officers on Deep Space 9 and, by 3195, a professor at Starfleet Academy.

hosts.note: Olympic gymnast; knew a young Leonard McCoy
Head of the Trill Symbiosis Commission
Test pilot, killed in a shuttle accident
Musician and murderer; the Commission suppressed his joining
Federation ambassador and Benjamin Sisko's mentor
Science officer on Deep Space 9, killed by Dukat
Stole the symbiont from Jadzia for a few hours
Counselor on Deep Space 9, joined aboard the USS Destiny
Professor at Starfleet Academy; hosts between Ezri and Illa are unrecorded

name: Tal
summary: A Trill symbiont of the 32nd century with seven hosts by 3189, four of them Starfleet officers. After the fifth, Admiral Senna, it passed within days from Gray to Adira, a Human, when an asteroid struck their generation ship.

hosts.note: Sixth host, joined aboard a generation ship outbound from Earth
Seventh host, joined days later after an asteroid struck the ship
